# Puhinka (Пухинка)

> Puhinka is a free breastfeeding timer and baby journal for iPhone, Android and the browser. It works as an installable web app at https://app.puhinka.com/, with no account and no ads; all records stay on the user's own device. It is a journal and a guide, not a medical device. Main language: Bulgarian, also available in English.

What it does: breastfeeding timer (left/right side, suggests the next side), bottle and pumping log, sleep, diapers, growth and other baby records, statistics, optional feeding reminders (the only feature that uses a server), and a local helper that answers questions from the user's own records. It works offline.

## Main pages

- [Puhinka - home (Bulgarian)](https://www.puhinka.com/): what the app does and how to start
- [Puhinka - home (English)](https://www.puhinka.com/en/): the same in English
- [Open the app](https://app.puhinka.com/): the web app itself, installable on the home screen
